name: Riviera Finance
summary: Long-standing factor for owner-operators and fleets with a 95% advance and no monthly minimums.
differentiator: Says term agreements "normally vary from three months to two years", the widest contract range any factor stated. Ask for the shortest term on offer and its rate.

terms.recourse: Recourse is lower cost; non-recourse costs slightly more and includes credit protection
terms.contract: Term agreements normally vary from three months to two years
terms.fuel: Fuel discounts at TA, Petro, Speedway, Roady's and others
